contract.description: What the Structured Output Parser asks the model for, and what Validate classification enforces on top of it. The parser guarantees the shape; the Code node guarantees the values.

schema_example.reason: Mentions being charged twice for one invoice.

fixture.note: Duplicate charge on a named invoice: the easy case. Measured: billing / urgent / 0.90 -> billing@lab.local.
HTTP 500 on an endpoint, auth ruled out in the text. Measured: technical / high / 0.80 -> support-tech@lab.local.

Arabic body and subject. Measured with llama3.2:3b: the category was right (shipping) but the model reported confidence 0.0, so it went to triage@lab.local - a normal outcome for a 3B model, not a bug.

Deliberately vague. Measured: category other, confidence 0.0 -> triage@lab.local. A model that answers 0.9 here would route it to support@lab.local, which is also defensible; the enums, not the confidence, are the real guard rail.

run_summary_shape._comment: Measured on 2026-09-07 with llama3.2:3b (temperature 0), 76 s for four tickets. Your run may differ; what must not differ is that nothing invalid reaches the tickets table.
run_summary_shape.notes: classified 4 ticket(s): 2 routed, 2 to the triage desk; 2 below min_confidence; category matched the seed label on 4/4 (100%)
